description: See every VS Code workspace storage and Copilot chat session at a glance: disk usage, session inventory, sessions missing from the panel, and stale index entries — all repairable in place. Deletions always go to the Recycle Bin and need your confirmation; the extension only recommends, it never deletes on its own.
config.title: Workspace Manager
config.recommendOrphans: Suggest deleting entries whose folder no longer exists or that have no workspace.json (nothing is deleted automatically).
config.bigSessionMB: Warn in the list when a chat session exceeds this many MB. Huge sessions usually mean tool output or base64 attachments were inlined into the session file.
command.renameSession: Rename Session (writes into the session file)
command.installAutoTask: Install Scheduled Task (apply pending renames while VS Code is closed)
